properties.description: Built 2026-10-28 (branch reading/prediction-order). crates/reflow2-core/src/foundation/store/engine/stamps.rs: every node write through the engine (create_node, create_node_imported, replace_node_properties, which every write path reaches) stores server_created_at, server_changed_at and server_seal in the node's stored property map, from this server's clock (fixed-width UTC to the microsecond). The seal is HMAC-SHA256 under a 32-byte key kept inside the store (a reserved embeddings-family key no graph's key can equal) over the design, node type and id, both times and the node's content hash. Identical content rewritten moves nothing; changed content keeps the creation time only when the old seal verifies here (an imported creation is never laundered); an import keeps a document's stamps as stated. A write naming a stamp is REFUSED. Every engine read (get_node, scan_nodes, the index scan) strips them, so replies, receipts, comparisons and content hashes are unchanged; DesignGraph::node_stamp reads them, recorded_here only when the seal verifies against the content as it stands. No store format change (no new column family). Exports carry them only with export_graph {stamps: true} (in node properties, which older readers accept; ExportedNode holds them apart in memory); an item-layout path refuses stamps and the layout writer clears them, so the design copy never carries them (dec:write-stamps-stay-in-the-store-and-travel-in-an-export-only-when-asked-2026-10-28, option C). flo2's backup tars and its move moves store directories, so the key and stamps travel there. An export's hash chain cannot vouch for a stamp: content_hash is an unkeyed SHA-256.
properties.name: reflow2 stamps each node's creation and content change with its own sealed time, and a caller cannot set it
